metadata.dcterms:title: FROM HOPF ALGEBRAS TO TENSOR CATEGORIES
metadata.dcterms:creator: ANDRUSKIEWITSCH, N.
ANGIONO, I.
IGLESIAS, A. GARCÍA
metadata.dcterms:abstract: This is a survey on spherical Hopf algebras. We give criteria to decide when a Hopf algebra is spherical and collect examples. We discuss tilting modules as a mean to obtain a fusion subcategory of the non-degenerate quotient of the category of representations of a suitable Hopf algebra.
